drivers.label: Early-down success
drivers.cue: Watch Kennesaw State on 1st down: gaining 4 or more yards keeps them out of 3rd-and-long. If Kennesaw State does that often, Kennesaw State's offense is winning this matchup; if not, Louisiana Tech's defense is.

detail.meaning: How often the offense has a successful play on normal downs: every 1st down, 2nd-and-7 or shorter, and 3rd or 4th-and-4 or shorter, on any set of downs in a drive (not just the first two plays). Successful means gaining half the yards needed on 1st down, 70% on 2nd, and all of it on 3rd or 4th.
detail.why: One of the 4 stats the model found actually decide games. Since 2015, the team with the better side of this matchup won 66% of the time.

drivers.label: Passing-down success
drivers.cue: Watch Louisiana Tech on 3rd-and-5 or longer: converting there keeps drives alive. If Louisiana Tech does that often, Louisiana Tech's offense is winning this matchup; if not, Kennesaw State's defense is.

detail.meaning: How often the offense has a successful play when it's behind schedule: 2nd-and-8 or longer, and 3rd or 4th-and-5 or longer. Successful means gaining 70% of the yards needed on 2nd down, and all of it on 3rd or 4th.
detail.why: One of the 4 stats the model found actually decide games. Since 2015, the team with the better side of this matchup won 63% of the time.

drivers.label: Big plays
drivers.cue: Watch for Kennesaw State plays of 20 or more yards; one or two can decide it. If Kennesaw State does that often, Kennesaw State's offense is winning this matchup; if not, Louisiana Tech's defense is.

detail.meaning: How big the good plays are: the average points added on the offense's successful plays. High numbers mean chunk gains, not just steady ones.
detail.why: One of the 4 stats the model found actually decide games. On its own it's close to a coin flip (since 2015, the team with the better side of this matchup won 52% of the time), but next to the other stats it adds real weight.

drivers.label: Points added per pass
drivers.cue: Watch Kennesaw State's first few drives through the air: completions of 15 or more yards. If Kennesaw State does that often, Kennesaw State's offense is winning this matchup; if not, Louisiana Tech's defense is.

detail.meaning: Points added per pass: how much the average pass play moves the offense toward scoring, based on down, distance and field position. Above zero helps the offense.
detail.why: One of the 4 stats the model found actually decide games. Since 2015, the team with the better side of this matchup won 64% of the time.
